title: VooPoo Argus G4 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus G4 Pod Kit perfectly balances pocket-friendly portability with advanced vaping technology. Powered by an exceptionally large 1650mAh built-in battery, this device delivers reliable all-day performance and features fast-charging capabilities that can fully replenish the battery in under 55 minutes. Driven by the intelligent Gene AI 3.0 Chipset, the Argus G4 provides a flexible 5W to 35W power range and is backed by eight comprehensive safety protections for complete peace of mind. It also features a highly convenient Smart Mode that automatically detects your pod and sets the optimal wattage, removing the guesswork from your daily setup. Navigation is straightforward thanks to the crisp 0.85-inch TFT screen and simple button controls. You can easily tailor your draw using the precise adjustable airflow slider, seamlessly switching between mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping styles. The kit includes two of the innovative Argus Multi-Ohm pods, equipped with a unique dual mesh coil and multi-core electrode technology designed to rapidly heat e-liquid and boost flavour clarity. With seamless inhale activation and broad compatibility across the entire Argus pod family, the Voopoo Argus G4 offers an incredibly versatile and dependable daily vape. Check out our vape juices and pair them perfectly with this kit. We recommend using the following E-Liquid: Voopoo Argus Multi-Ohm (1.0ohm, 0.7ohm, 0.4ohm) Pod - For 1.0ohm & 0.7ohm use Nic salts E-liquids and for 0.4ohm use high VG (sub-ohm) E-Liquids. Voopoo Argus V2 0.4ohm Pod - Use high VG E-Liquid (sub-ohm) - Choose Double Drip. Voopoo Argus V2 0.7ohm Pod - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 (freebase) - Choose Bar Salts. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
